_about: Kansas City grocery directory for `shop grocery`. Business addresses only; nothing personal. Chains with a live store API (Price Chopper, Sun Fresh, Cosentino's Market, Costco) are enriched at runtime from that API; the entries here are the fixed ids and the facts an API does not carry (closures, operators, what each lane covers). A chain's `instacart` object (lane, host, slug) enables the guest online-price lane in instacart_guest.py. Verified 2026-10-07.

pricechopper.name: Price Chopper KC
pricechopper.notes: 50 stores, four operators (Ball, Cosentino, McKeever, Queen). Weekly ad: Flipp merchant 4282 'Price Chopper KC' (full ad, ~230 items) with mypricechopper.com FrontPageAdGroupsForPreferredStore/<StoreId> as the highlights fallback. Shelf prices are not published; online prices come from the Instacart storefront www.shopmypricechopper.com as a guest (lane pricechopper-online; the bare domain 302s to www).

cosentinos.name: Cosentino's Market
cosentinos.notes: Three Cosentino's Market stores (Downtown, Brookside, Overland Park). Weekly ad: PDF from the site's Strapi `ads` collection, OCR'd. Digital coupons: Midax EZConnect, keyed by LocationCouponID. Cosentino's also operates Price Chopper stores; those are under pricechopper. Online shop: www.mymarketdelivers.com, an Instacart storefront read as a guest (lane cosentinos-online). The bare domain mymarketdelivers.com is a different host with no TLS; always use www.

sunfresh.name: Sun Fresh Market
sunfresh.notes: Freshop (NCR) back end, app_key sun_fresh. The products endpoint is empty for every store (0 rows; app_key festival_foods returns priced rows, so the endpoint works and Sun Fresh has no catalog). The circular is an image-only PDF per store, so the lane OCRs it. Not on Flipp or Instacart.

costco.name: Costco
costco.notes: Online search: search.costco.com typeahead (names, item numbers) then the product page's schema.org Offer for the online price. Online price is not the warehouse price; warehouse prices are not published. Weekly coupon book: Flipp merchant 2519 'Costco ' (trailing space in Flipp's data). Same-Day grocery: sameday.costco.com, an Instacart storefront with a 'Browse as a guest' landing page (lane costco-sameday).

wholefoods.name: Whole Foods Market
wholefoods.notes: wholefoodsmarket.com/api/search?text=&store=<id>: shelf regularPrice/salePrice, no key. One store id per location.

aldi.name: ALDI
aldi.notes: Weekly ad on Flipp (merchant ALDI). Online shop www.aldi.us, an Instacart storefront read as a guest (lane aldi-online; shop.aldi.us and aldi.instacart.com redirect there). No ALDI store entry in the directory yet.

henhouse.name: Hen House Market
henhouse.notes: Ball's Foods. Online shop henhouse.instacart.com, an Instacart storefront read as a guest (lane henhouse-online; the ZIP picks the store). Weekly ad is an AWG adstudio.com JavaScript viewer with no public item feed found (checked 2026-10-07).

unitedmarket.name: United Market KC
unitedmarket.notes: AWG Nuxt site like Hen House; same adstudio.com ad viewer, no public item feed found. Opened 2026-05-20. No lane; directory only.

midtownmarket.name: Midtown Market
midtownmarket.notes: Independent international grocer. No website of its own (midtownmarket.com is an unrelated store in Kentucky). Walk-in only.

coordinate_overrides._about: chain:id -> [lat, lon, why]. Applied over live API coordinates that are wrong.
cosentinos:200144: Strapi places Brookside at the downtown store's coordinates; 14 W 62nd Terrace is at 62nd and Brookside Blvd.

stores.name: Costco Midtown #375
stores.note: Closed 2026-10-01; reopens as a Costco Business Center in spring 2027. Not in the warehouse locator any more. Nearest open warehouse is N Kansas City #1268, 1600 NW 88th St.

stores.name: Midtown Market International Grocery
stores.note: Near the 39th St streetcar stop. Open per third-party listings with customer reviews dated August 2026 (Loc8NearMe; Yelp lists it as Midtown Market International Grocery Store). No digital price surface: walk-in only.

stores.name: Hen House Market
stores.note: All Hen House stores are in Johnson County, KS; none downtown. Listed for completeness.
